summary: Demcon is industrial machinery company from the Netherlands, founded in 1993. Type: private company. About 498 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 90% of its 10 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

culture.text: Describes an open, informal atmosphere with a flat structure and multidisciplinary teams on complex projects.
Staff come mainly from University of Twente, Saxion, TU Eindhoven and TU Delft, studying mechanical and electrical engineering.
A group of 20+ specialised companies with over 1,200 employees, working in mechatronics, robotics, optics and machine learning.

open.text: Several Demcon companies in Delft and Eindhoven are IND recognised sponsors.
Has branches in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States.

growth.text: Founded in 1993 and grown over 30 years into a group of more than 1,200 employees.
Calls itself a growing organisation in its job ads.

worth_knowing.text: Works in sectors including medical, defence and security, agri-food and aerospace, which may matter if you have preferences about defence work.
